commitResults.messageTitle: Update Site Settings and part of the DG
commitResults.messageBody:
Tutoria still refers to AB3 in parts of its site settings, and does not
reflect our user stories and some use cases for Tutoria.

This mismatch of information will confuse future users of Tutorias they
will see mentions of AB3, or non-Tutoria related information.

Let's update any mentions of AB3 in the site settings, update the user
stories in the Deevloper's guide to match those of our own, and add
some relevant use cases.

This will update our site settings and developer guide to be more
relevant to Tutoria than with AB3.
Update Site Settings and part of the DG

The user presently can only find contacts by name and not details.

This is not helpful since tutors may remark students with "deficient in
math" or "monitor closely" and want to find those particular students,
hence needing a way to search all of a contact's aattributes.

Let's add a Search command that will go through all of the present
attributes in a Person class (Name, Address, Email, Tags and Phone) by
making similar classes to the Find command, and making a predicate that
checks all attributes.

This serves as a stepping stone by seeing what is possible at the app's
base stage, and will allow the user to find contacts based on any
attribute.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Search highlighting and update the UG
commitResults.messageBody:
While the code could search for each Person, it did not show which text
it matched with the given keyword, making it difficult for the user to
know why a search result turned up at first glance. The user guide also
does not reflect any searching functionality.

This can make searching difficult, and the user experience worse.

Let's modify the fxml parts of Person, along with PersonCard and
PersonListPanel, to incorporate highlighting functionaltiy, where it
uses the indexes of the found keywords and uses appropriate css to alter
its color to appear highlighted.

This will ensure users are able to easily see their keywords within
search results.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add initial undo and redo functionality
commitResults.messageBody:
Some commands are difficult or long to execute, and if users mistype
something it takes a lot of effort to undo their changes.

This can lead to some dissatisfaction.

Let's add undo and redo functionality so users can seemlessly undo their
commands if needed, and if they still require it, redo whatever they
undid.

This ensures users won't have to type every command out again and
enables them to work faster with a CLI.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for undo and redo functionality
commitResults.messageBody:
Previous code had no tests for the new code.

If any future changes are made there will be no easy way to test them.

Let's add tests for undo, redo, and update existing tests for other code
that was changed.

This ensures that integration and regression tests can include this
functionaltiy as well.
Add undo and redo functionality

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for search and fix null bug
commitResults.messageBody:
Code previously lacked tests for some of the parent search
functionality, and there was a bug where if a parent had an empty field
the search command would fail.

This makes testing harder since it is not automated, and the app may not
work for users who search.

Let's implement some tests for classes associated to searching for
parents where appropriate, and fix the buy by checking if the field is
null.

This fixes the error and ensures users won't run into bugs when
searching.
